summary: NexGen Energy Ltd., a Canadian uranium developer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report containing standard financial disclosures, including balance sheet, income statement, and related notes. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, capital returns, or strategic reviews are disclosed. The report also includes customary CEO and CFO certifications. As a routine periodic filing by a foreign private issuer, it does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
